desc: Agitating this muddy liquid brings little bits into view: a fish scale, hummingbird tongue, a cat claw, or a squirrel hair.
When you drink this potion, you can cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.hDOENzjuj5WpLq7B]{Animal Friendship}  spell (save DC 13) for 1 hour at will.
name: potion of animal friendship
